summary: Built and verified the HA Prometheus/Thanos stack. Thanos deduplicates 8 raw replica series to 4 hosts, historical queries survive a Prometheus replica outage, and all services/data persisted across sequential node restarts.
actions_performed: Configured independent Prometheus replicas and Thanos sidecars on node1 and node2.
Configured node_exporter on all four nodes and verified all four host targets.
Configured Thanos query, store gateway, and compactor on node3.
Configured authenticated HTTPS MinIO on node4:9000 with bucket thanos-metrics and durable data under /srv/thanos-objectstore.
Created protected object-store variables at /root/thanos-objectstore.env on node3.
Stopped and restored one Prometheus replica to verify current and historical query continuity.
Restarted node1 through node4 individually and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Independent Prometheus replicas collecting all four hosts
evidence.summary: Both replicas are active/enabled with persistent TSDB blocks; each reports four managed hosts. Final Thanos output explicitly lists node1-node4.

evidence.requirement: Thanos query, store, and compaction services on node3
evidence.summary: Query, store, compactor, and exporter are active/enabled and ready on their expected listeners with no recent errors.
The same current query returns 8 series with deduplication disabled and 4 with deduplication enabled.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated HTTPS object store, bucket, and durable data path
evidence.summary: MinIO is HTTPS-ready on port 9000; unauthenticated bucket access returns 403, authenticated access confirms thanos-metrics with 24 objects, and /srv/thanos-objectstore persisted.
/root/thanos-objectstore.env is root-owned mode 0600 and contains the required access, endpoint, and bucket variable names.

evidence.requirement: Prometheus replica outage continuity and historical retention
evidence.summary: With node1 Prometheus and sidecar confirmed unavailable, Thanos remained ready and returned 4 current and 4 historical host series; node1 was then restored.
Captured healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered Prometheus/sidecar/exporter and TSDB data, then full cluster query health.

Captured healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered all Thanos services, protected environment file, stores, and current/historical queries.
Captured healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered MinIO/exporter, TLS certificate, data directory, and persisted bucket objects.
